text:
You haven’t undone your recovery. Three pizza nights is a bump, not a reset.

| Right now | Do this |
|---|---|
| Tonight | Eat your next meal normally: protein + carbs + something with fiber/veg. No “making up for it.” |
| Tomorrow | Go back to your usual routine. One good day beats one perfect promise. |
| Mindset | Treat this as data, not failure. The goal is consistency over weeks, especially while you’re healing. |
| If this was stress-eating | We can make a very low-friction plan for the next 3 evenings so dinner is easier. |

If you want, I can help you build a 24-hour reset plan that fits recovery and keeps things simple.

attributes.reason: Reassuring and non-shaming, with a gentle tone rather than pushing hard.
Centers recovery and healing, not performance or optimization.
Uses a clear table to organize the advice into rows and columns.
